data.indexFullNameCn: 中证新能源汽车产业指数
data.indexFullNameEn: CSI New Energy Vehicles Industry Index
data.indexCnDesc: 中证新能源汽车产业指数选取50只业务涉及新能源整车、电机电控、锂电设备、电芯电池、电池材料等新能源汽车产业的上市公司证券作为指数样本，反映新能源汽车产业龙头上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI New Energy Vehicles Industry Index selects 50 securities involving new energy vehicles, electric motors and electronic controls, lithium equipment, battery cells and battery materials as the constituents. The index is to measure the performance of top new energy vehicles industry securities.
